newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia, Syria seek ways to expand trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia, Syria seek ways to expand trade.

text.p: Syrian Prime Minister Mahmoud Zu'bi arrived in Jakarta on Thursday on a four-day official visit to discuss economic and trade relations between the two countries.

"The focus of the visit is mainly to seek ways to expand economy and to boost trade," Foreign Minister Ali Alatas told Reuters shortly after Zu'bi paid a brief courtesy call on Indonesian President Suharto.
"There is also the possibility to discuss developments in the Middle East," he added.
Zu'bi is scheduled to hold official talks with Suharto on Friday before visiting the state-owned aircraft industry PT Industri Pesawat Terbang Nusantara (IPTN) in Bandung, West Java, on Saturday.
He will visit the holiday isle of Bali before returning to Syria on Sunday.
